The '''Orma system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orma]]. It was named after the [[Orma (akia)|Orma]] [[akia]] of [[Aramandi]] society.
